title: should (2) (I don't think you should ~ / Should I ~?)
goal: I think / I don't think you should ~로 부드럽게 의견을 말하고, Should I ~?로 상대의 조언을 물어볼 수 있어요.

points.title: I think you should ~
points.body: should 앞에 I think를 붙이면 '~하는 게 좋을 것 같아요'처럼 더 부드러운 조언이 돼요. (I think you should take the job.)

points.title: I don't think you should ~
points.body: '~ 안 하는 게 좋을 것 같아요'는 영어로 보통 think를 부정해서 I don't think you should ~라고 해요. I think you shouldn't ~보다 이 말이 훨씬 자연스러워요.

points.title: Should I ~? = 제가 ~할까요?
points.body: should를 주어 앞으로 보내면 '~해야 할까요? / ~할까요?'라는 질문이 돼요. 대답은 Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't.예요. do는 쓰지 않아요.

points.title: Do you think I should ~?
points.body: 상대의 의견을 정중하게 물을 때는 Do you think I should ~?라고 해요. 이때 뒷부분은 질문 순서가 아니라 I should 순서 그대로예요.

formula: I don't think + 주어 + should + 동사원형
Do you think + 주어 + should + 동사원형 ~?

mistakes.wrong: Do I should bring my resume?
mistakes.why: should가 있는 질문은 do를 쓰지 않고 should를 맨 앞으로 보내요.

mistakes.wrong: I think you not should go.
mistakes.right: I don't think you should go.
mistakes.why: not을 should 앞에 넣을 수 없어요. '안 하는 게 좋을 것 같다'는 I don't think you should ~가 가장 자연스러워요.
질문에서도 should 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형이에요.

examples.en: I think you should take the job.
examples.ko: 그 일자리를 잡는 게 좋을 것 같아요.

examples.en: I don't think you should drive tonight. You're tired.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤엔 운전 안 하는 게 좋을 것 같아요. 피곤하잖아요.

examples.en: Should I bring my resume to the interview?
Should we take the tram or walk?
Do you think I should move to Brisbane?
I don't think she should quit her job.
examples.ko: 그녀가 일을 그만두지 않는 게 좋을 것 같아요.

examples.en: A: Should I tell my housemate? B: Yes, you should.
examples.ko: A: 하우스메이트한테 말할까요? B: 네, 그러는 게 좋아요.

examples.en: I think we should book the hostel now.
examples.ko: 지금 호스텔을 예약하는 게 좋을 것 같아요.

Does

don't should
should to
shoulds

quiz.why: I don't think you should + 동사원형. 부정은 이미 don't think에 있어요.

choices: get
gets

don't

doesn't
not

quiz.ko: 차는 안 사는 게 좋을 것 같아요. 대중교통으로 충분해요.

choices: Should I open the window?

quiz.ko: 그녀에게 사과하는 게 좋을 것 같아요.
quiz.answer: I think you should say sorry to her.
choices: I think you should say sorry to her.
I think you should to say sorry to her.
I think you shoulds say sorry to her.
I think should you say sorry to her.
quiz.why: I think + you should + 동사원형. 질문이 아니니 should you로 뒤집지 않아요.

quiz.ko: 우리 지금 떠나지 않는 게 좋을 것 같아요.
quiz.answer: I don't think we should leave now.
choices: I don't think we should leave now.
I think we don't should leave now.
I don't think we should leaving now.
I not think we should leave now.
quiz.why: '~ 안 하는 게 좋을 것 같다'는 I don't think + 주어 + should + 동사원형이에요.

quiz.answer: Do you think I should ask the manager?
choices: Do you think I should ask the manager?
Do you think should I ask the manager?
Do you think I should asking the manager?
Are you think I should ask the manager?
quiz.why: Do you think 뒤에는 I should 순서 그대로 + 동사원형이에요.

choices: Should I take an umbrella?

Should I takes an umbrella?
Should I to take an umbrella?
quiz.why: should 질문에는 do가 필요 없고, 뒤에는 동사원형이에요.

quiz.answer: I don't think he should work so late.
choices: I don't think he should work so late.
I think he not should work so late.
I don't think he should works so late.
I doesn't think he should work so late.
quiz.why: I don't think + he should + 동사원형이에요.

quiz.answer: Should we bring something to the barbecue?
choices: Should we bring something to the barbecue?
Should we to bring something to the barbecue?
Do we should bring something to the barbecue?
Should we brings something to the barbecue?
